label: D1 reward after a rare a2->S1 transition, mid-episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1 (100% of activations), i.e. when the previous trial was rewarded. Among rewarded D1 steps it is selective for the previous trial having reached S1: rare a2->S1 rewarded trials are the strongest drivers (prev_common==0 gives 2.7x lift, ~59% of mass), and the remaining ~40% of mass is mostly common a1->S1 rewarded trials. It is strongly modulated by episode time: almost silent in trials 0-9 and after trial ~70, peak at trials 20-60, so it also depends on slowly drifting hidden state. Never active at GO or D2, nor on unrewarded D1. Only observed variables are used (previous choice, reached state, reward input). Activations are tiny (max ~0.002) so magnitude claims are not made. Broader alternative (D1 & in_rew==1 & prev_state==1 & ep_trial 10-69) has mass recall 0.84 but precision 0.15.
